name: Fettle
description: A Plotform adaptation for a community workshop and class programme, drawn rather than photographed: squared paper, a workbench in elevation, cards with the uneven corners of a hand sketched rectangle, a floor plan and a bar chart in pencil, and a class full of people who are all illustrations. No photography anywhere.
designNotes: Plotform adaptation of the one idea PaperCSS rests on, that a page can look drawn from borders, radii and shadows alone, not an unchanged upstream template. Its remote Google Fonts import was dropped and one OFL face bundled locally instead.

Every graphic is generated once at build time and shipped as a static SVG: the rules, frames, callout, tool sketches, floor plan and chart with Rough.js, seeded so the strokes never move, and the people from Open Peeps, public domain under CC0. No photography and no generated images.
The fourteen weekly sessions filter by level and by evening at the same time, with a live count of sessions and benches free, operable by mouse and by the arrow keys, across six pages.
